checks_run: Inventoried all 36 candidate files, checked entry types, and reviewed learner-visible documentation, starter code, tests, and tooling without modifying CANDIDATE.
Verified configured-tool and host-tool versions, parsed all Python and JSON inputs, reran the structure/credential audit, and checked recorded content hashes.
Built the starter and sealed reference with the candidate helper and built the reference independently with direct /usr/bin/as and /usr/bin/ld invocations.
Ran the builder-provided public suite (10/10 passed) and sealed reference suite (13/13 passed).

Ran 46 independent bounded black-box assertions, including 80 seeded random arithmetic, bitwise, comparison, division, and remainder tuples plus exact and one-past resource cases; all passed after correcting one reviewer-side assertion.

Ran a QEMU 9.1.1 smoke check with the configured GLib, a small explicitly unvalidated benchmark smoke check, repeated-build comparison, symlink-policy adversarial check, and audit-coverage inspection.
evidence: The reference directly assembled and linked to a static ELF64 x86-64 executable with global _start and a non-executable GNU_STACK; its smoke output was exactly 144 followed by a newline.
The candidate's public and sealed suites reproduced the recorded 10/10 and 13/13 passing results, and the independent harness passed 46/46 process assertions under three-second timeouts.

Two same-input build.py runs produced different SHA-256 values, 168135573ab6c105edea98a0c8c2c0ef3ed1044baf944079634b56129c811896 and 3b212d83269df78e2b9bc0e7fd693f1600f41dd4a5ac37c8c390386347906b1f, because distinct random cinder-build-* object paths were embedded in .strtab.
build.py returned 0 when source, assembler, and linker were all supplied through symlinks, contradicting its regular non-symlink diagnostic and environment documentation.
audit.py passed on the current tree but its REQUIRED tuple omits starter/forth.S, starter/Makefile, public_tests/test_cinder.py, environment/build.py, environment/audit.py, and benchmarks/run.py.
The audit's provenance_binding check compares only snapshot_sha256 and project_id, so it does not integrity-bind the remaining license and source assertions in PROVENANCE.json.
All builder-recorded candidate content hashes reproduced, and MANIFEST.yaml honestly retains only GENERATED and PARTIAL with independent validation required and productionized false.
Reviewer scratch binaries, object files, and test symlinks were explicitly removed after evidence capture; the immutable candidate and the three review deliverables remain.
limitations: The immutable upstream catalog snapshot and linked resource were not available for independent source, license, similarity, or clean-room authentication; those provenance assertions remain inconclusive.
The sealed tree is readable in this reviewer workspace. Student-view exclusion is an external control-plane property and was not transfer-verified here.
No pinned x86-64 binutils root was configured, so native builds relied on absolute system paths /usr/bin/as and /usr/bin/ld at the recorded version 2.30-123.el8.
The configured QEMU binary initially failed without the configured GLib on LD_LIBRARY_PATH, then passed one smoke case with that library path; this is not TRANSFER_VERIFIED evidence.
No fuzzing, production, or general performance conclusion was attempted; the benchmark smoke result remains explicitly unvalidated.
